quest.title: The Saga of Mr. Forgetful
quest.description: The famous adventurer Roald is still on Tsurumi Island, seemingly troubled by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x20000

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: Ah, so you're still on this island as well. That's great.

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: How have you been lately? Any shocking discoveries? Let's hear them, shall we?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Ah, but that's normal. Don't sweat it, I'd say. Islands like this never lack for mysteries, and I have full confidence that you'll stumble upon something eventually.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Actually, Paimon's got a question. What are you doing here, Roald?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Me? Oh, I was just packing my things up and preparing to leave.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: The fog here is too bizarre. Step into it for a bit, and you lose your way... And before you know it, you're right back where you started.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: I'd forgotten the path that Kama pointed out to me before, so I tried looking for some natives to show me the way, but I couldn't find any path no matter how I tried...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: My compass, the shadows on the ground... None of these help in telling directions here... I've even tried using my shoes, but nope! I couldn't take a single step further into the fog.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Your... shoes?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: He means that he used them as waymarkers.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What...!?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: #Haha! As expected of you, {NICKNAME}! You're well-versed in adventuring tricks, indeed! You've got much to learn, Paimon!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Yes, much to learn you have, Paimon.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come on, that's just called trying your luck! Paimon doesn't have to learn that!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Either way, my progress has ground to a halt.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: *sigh* If I had tied a rope to a nearby tree and tried to advance while holding on to its other end tightly, I could probably have made a few more attempts.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So why didn't you try again?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: I used up the backup shoes that I brought along to help tell which way I was going...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Well, they shouldn't have been, but I, uh... I threw too many of them and kept forgetting to retrieve them, so... I ran out over time, you know?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Wait. That's right! I finally remembered! I've got something to ask of you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, well, what a surprise!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Haha, uh, sorry...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: As you know, I have a rather shameful habit of constantly forgetting things.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: My poor memory has gotten me into hot water more than a few times, especially since I'm an adventurer and all...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: And one of my goals for coming to Tsurumi Island was to collect something known as Fluorescent Fungi. According to Sango, these fungi can help improve one's memory and relieve strain on one's brain. It's said that they can even improve visual acuity.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: The last time I came here with Kama, I was so preoccupied with "meeting the locals" that I forgot to collect any... *sigh*

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: I also didn't expect that I would encounter so much trouble after coming to the island on my own. It's a real shame...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: So if you still have adventuring plans in this area, could you help me pick a few of these Fluorescent Fungi?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Thank you so much!

choices.text: Just don't forget about me when the time comes.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Haha! I won't, don't worry!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: *sigh* It is, isn't it?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Is that so? Haha! Well, don't let me slow you down, then!

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: Hmm, this should be enough, yes! Thank you ever so much!

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: By the way, if you find anything interesting near the island's ceremonial site, do give me a shout as well.

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: Hmm. Ah, yes. I do believe that you have a Fontaine-built Kamera with you, right? That's a rather expensive gadget to be sure... I should really get myself one of those, should my budget allow.

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: I've heard local historians say that the ancient natives of Tsurumi Island would use paintings to depict ancient, now-unremembered history onto the rock walls of caves, and that most of these murals have lasted over a thousand years now...

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: During my previous trip here, I was able to catch a glimpse of these images by ceremonial fire-light... They occupied my thoughts for several restless nights, and were most hard to forget indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: I don't believe that anyone has ever witnessed the murals in full, but if you could bring back proof of their existence, this will surely constitute a major breakthrough for the Adventurers' Guild in the field of historical academia.

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: If you find those legendary murals, take as many clear pictures of them as you can. I will purchase the photos from you for use in my diaries for a fair price and reward you for your trouble to boot.

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: What do you say? Is this arrangement acceptable?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Thank you very much!

choices.text: As long as you don't lose your diary again.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: I'll... I'll try my best.

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: Hello there, you two! Found anything lately?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: No rush. I'll be here waiting!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Thanks for the Fluorescent Fungi you gave me, by the way. They're really fresh!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah, yeah, easy for you to say. Didn't we give you those mushrooms in the first place?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Ah, come now, don't sweat the small stuff. I mean, I've been eating them, haven't I?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...You... You forgetful...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Rest here for a bit if you're tired, maybe have a Fluorescent Fungus or two!

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}! And hello there, {NICKNAME}'s gabby fairy friend!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And hello to you too, Mister Forgetful!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon. Is. Paimon! Don't you forget that!

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: I won't, Little Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Wait, were you just playing Paimon!? Where did your manners go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #You know what, {NICKNAME}? Just give this guy those weird mushrooms already. Paimon's not talking to him!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will this be enough?

talks.objective: Take a photo of the ruin murals

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: #We meet again, {NICKNAME}, and your, uh, um...

dialogues.speaker: Roald
dialogues.text: Could I ask what you'd sell this flying fellow for? I think she's quite interesting!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eh!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: He's clearly not alright! This guy's having that amnesia thing again!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: What on earth are you saying... *hurk*

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: *hurk*... Ahahahaha!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Hahahaha! *cough* Ahahah! Just... Just look at the looks on your faces! Hehahah!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: I'm done... I'm out of breath... S—Sorry... This... Ahahaha... This is a favored "joke" of mine, you know?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's not funny at all!

choices.text: I'm afraid I don't get your sense of humor.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: *cough* Alright, alright, no more jokes. I'm sorry.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really! Paimon thought a famous adventurer like you would be a more serious person!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Haha. It might be best not to have too fixed a view of adventurers. The Guild is well-known as a circle of oddities. I'd even call myself "normal" amidst their ranks.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Not by much, Paimon thinks.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Still, thank you for those mushrooms. Their effects haven't been all that evident so far. Perhaps they need long-term use to really take effect, or maybe they don't have medicinal properties at all... But either way, they taste pretty good.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: I should be careful not to finish all of these. I need to leave some for my friend in Sumeru who can help to research any medicinal properties that they may have.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: I feel like you're just going to forget this...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: *cough* Ahem, well, back on topic. Have the two of you gone looking for the murals yet?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, here's the photos that you wanted.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Ooh, my thanks for your most generous aid!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Let's see. Interesting, very interesting. Hmm... Did you find any other murals?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Hmm, that's even more interesting, then.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What do you mean?

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: The people of Tsurumi Island used to worship a monstrous bird that wielded the power of Electro, and their civilization was centered around rituals and other ceremonial affairs to this effect. Most people who know something of history do not contest this view...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: But the murals that you've provided show no sign of the Thunderbird's presence at all. It seems that the people worshiped something else altogether—

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: That is to say, the sun, moon, and stars... and whatever these strange symbols represent. Perhaps Tsurumi Island's natives already had a certain degree of civilization before the Thunderbird's descent...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Other than those, the fog and the moonlight, the stars and the darkness... Hmm, I can't explain these...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Best not to use your head too much, Roald. Who knows what that'll do to your memory...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: ...Ah, yes. Sorry. I was lost in thought. Barely even noticed you two, really.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Thanks once again for your hard work. I think this much is enough for me to write my next diary... If it gets picked up by some historians, I won't forget to add the two of you to the acknowledgments section!

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Alright then. I think it's time I reported back to the Guild. Sorry for all the time I've taken up. May we meet again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What a busy guy...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Ah, right. There is one other thing. Nothing major, mind, but I hope that you could help me look out for someone. It's that child I mentioned earlier, whose name was... Um... Give me a moment...

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Right, "Ruu." That was his name. I brought some things along this time for him to eat... I hope they're still fresh.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: Ever since the last time I came here, I've been thinking about that kid. I can't imagine that life has been easy for him on such a perilous island.

response.speaker: Roald
response.text: #Alright, you'll hear no more from me. Let us meet again on the next leg of our respective journeys, {NICKNAME}! Ad astra abyssosque!

choices.text: These were all we could find.
I guess this is how forgetful people survive, eh?
Did the Fluorescent Fungus from before work?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's right! Why does it seem like he's gotten worse instead!?
